original.status: EXPLORATORY ONLY; noncausal archive filtering unverified
original.label: target_depth_bin_t_plus_10min_cm
original.target_semantics: last physical observation in bin (t+5min,t+10min], NOT instantaneous depth at t+10
original.selection_rule: min validation (MAE target>=10cm + MAE target<10cm)/2; tie overall MAE then ID
original.baseline_linear_trend: max(0, current depth + 10 * past5min slope); does not use future source age
original.training_row_policy: ALL original selected-core eligible windows; no offline review mask and no sampling
original.wet_weight_policy: TRAIN label>=10cm gets fixed weight20 in two candidates only; labels not features
original.prediction_postprocessing: clip negative predictions to zero, no upper clipping
original.test_policy: load once after validation choice; never early stopping or candidate selection on test
original.test_history_caveat: 2023 has prior exploratory inspection; NOT a pristine confirmatory holdout
scientific_limits: No verified ground-truth flood labels or field validation.
Processed depths can contain unverified noncausal filtering or sensor noise.
Core station widely_proud_lizard has a visually ambiguous possible-box case.
Overlapping windows are correlated; counts are not counts of independent events.
New crossing recall is window-level and not event-level warning lead time.
Different seasons/station availability across validation/test can shift metrics.
No claim of transferability to ESP32 or local flood dynamics.
Model/data-derived artifacts stay local; clarify FloodNet rights before distribution.

preprocessing.bin: 5min UTC (t-5min,t], finalized at t; no unfinished bins
preprocessing.aggregation: median of finite raw depths in the current completed bin
preprocessing.null_policy: empty bin or nonfinite raw on LAST physical row -> missing; do not fall back to an earlier valid row
preprocessing.negative_raw: max(raw_mm,0) before median; retain counts/flags, not a declaration of sensor failure
preprocessing.high_values_and_jumps: retain; no upper clipping or hard gradient/outlier rejection
preprocessing.missing: no interpolation, forward/backward fill or synthetic observations
preprocessing.history: three raw-derived bins t-10,t-5,t; full support (t-15min,t]
preprocessing.label: last physical processed-depth observation in (t+5min,t+10min], finite and nonnegative
preprocessing.proc_usage: future supervised label and retrospective comparison ONLY; never an input or history eligibility rule
preprocessing.arrival_assumption: raw observations assumed available at archive timestamps; transport/calibration latency not reconstructed
preprocessing.filter_scope: reduces some within-bin transients when multiple samples exist; cannot reliably remove sustained boxes or sparse blips

station_policy: exact original 3 core; no seven additional stations; no reranking
training_rows: all eligible raw-history/future-proc-label windows; counts differ from proc branch
selection: min balanced MAE on ALL raw-eligible validation rows; tie overall MAE, persistence, ID
paired_policy: common validation rows only, reported AFTER selection; training memberships can differ
test_policy: NO TEST FILES OR JULY-2023-ONWARD SOURCE CACHES LOADED
label: target_depth_bin_t_plus_10min_cm
fit_target: future proc label minus current RAW-DERIVED depth
weight_policy: unchanged: future proc label >=10cm receives candidate wet_weight
model_and_validation: same 4 XGBoost configs, seed42, CPU<=4 threads; no early stopping/refit
limits: Causal with respect to archive raw observation order, NOT verified arrival-time/clock/calibration behavior.
Future processed labels are offline proxies, not independently verified flood depths.
Median can attenuate fast changes; one-sample bins cannot reject blips; persistent objects can survive.
Negative raw is floored, not repaired calibration or proof of dry conditions.
Station selection originally used proc train statistics; no claim of raw-only station selection.
Raw/proc training rows differ; common validation does not remove that training-data confound.
Repeatedly inspected validation is exploratory; no claim of real-time 10-minute accuracy or local transfer.
No ESP32, API, frontend, routing or live alerts modified; artifacts local under FloodNet terms.
